name: Syncthing
summary: Keep folders in sync between your devices, without a cloud.
description: Continuous peer-to-peer file synchronisation. Devices connect to the sync port; the web interface manages folders and devices. Set a GUI password on first start.

fields.name: PORT
fields.label: Port
fields.description: Port on this server for the web interface.

fields.name: SYNC_PORT
fields.label: Sync port
fields.description: Port other devices connect to (TCP and UDP).
